meta.name: company-intel
meta.description: Research a company, industry, or competitor set using web search and seven analytical lenses. Use when you need structured intel that feeds downstream PM skills.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用七个分析维度研究公司、行业或竞品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做产品决策前需要结构化商业情报
copy.tagline_en: Research companies, industries, or competitors with seven analytical lenses
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need structured business intelligence before product decisions

howto.what: 你让它研究公司、行业或一组竞争对手时,Claude 会用网络搜索,按财务、产品、竞争等七个角度分析,输出带来源的结构化情报,供战报、SWOT 等下游技能使用。
howto.when: 当你说出公司名、行业名或 2-5 家竞争对手,或要求“研究某公司的竞争对手”时触发;也可直接给公司网址。

say.text: 用 company-intel 调研耐克,重点看财务和产品组合。
say.note: 生成带来源的单公司完整报告。

say.text: 研究特斯拉的竞争对手,列出来确认后再深入分析。
say.note: 先给候选人清单,确认后才逐家分析。

say.text: 对比微软、谷歌和亚马逊,给我交叉比较。
say.note: 输出三家公司各自的报告和对比章节。

howto.what_en: Claude switches to a research-engine mode: it web-searches a company, industry, or competitor set, analyzes through seven lenses, and outputs cited structured intel that downstream PM skills can consume.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you name a company, an industry, or a set of 2-5 competitors; when you ask to discover a company's competitors; or when you provide a company URL.

say_en.text: Use company-intel to research Nike, focusing on financials and product portfolio.
say_en.note: Produces a full single-company report with sources.

say_en.text: Find Tesla's competitors, list them for confirmation, then dive deeper.
say_en.note: Shows a candidate list first, then analyzes each confirmed one.

say_en.text: Compare Microsoft, Google, and Amazon with a cross-company view.
say_en.note: Outputs per-company reports plus a cross-company comparison.
